$comment: Every lint escape in shipped code (packages/*/src, except vendored code). scripts/check-type-escapes.ts fails on any escape not listed here, and on any entry that no longer matches. Add one only when no typed alternative exists, with the reason.

allowed.reason: The two overloads of ExplorerVerifyError.is and ExplorerVerifyError[Symbol.hasInstance] check a Symbol.for brand, so they hold for an error from another copy of the package, and narrow the value to one class type per code, so a check of error.code narrows details. TypeScript narrows a value only through a predicate. Decision 0044.

isHandleString narrows a string to HandleString, the template literal type of the one-line handle form. TypeScript narrows a value to a template literal type only through a predicate. It holds: isHandleString is true only for a string parseHandle accepts, and parseHandle reads a string only as the one-line form. Decision 0050.
